name: WCF-Bench-v2 measurement-instrument FREEZE manifest (session 16)
status: FROZEN (owner ruling, STOP-POINT 1 s16: freeze as-is with residuals disclosed; no guard round). Any later edit to template, panel, aggregation, or packet pipeline is a NEW instrument and restarts validation (bank-versioning rule extended to judge-mode).

template.lineage: s14 strict + three s15 audit-prescribed guards (preamble-scan, trap-request, owner-ruled strict substitute pricing)

judges.channel: Claude Agent dispatch (claude-opus tier), fresh context per verdict, verdict written to file, $0

codex exec OAuth, hardened invocation (--ephemeral --ignore-user-config --ignore-rules --sandbox read-only --skip-git-repo-check -c model=gpt-5.6-sol -c model_reasoning_effort=high -c web_search=disabled -c features.multi_agent=false, empty workdir, stdin </dev/null), fresh process per verdict, $0

panel.aggregation: mean-of-2 per (item, SUT) cell; per-judge grades retained for sensitivity reporting
panel.parse_contract: strict last-match 'GRADE: <int>'; one re-prompt with minimal format reminder on failure, then parse-failure

packet_pipeline.renderer: analysis/session15_bench_packets.py machinery: answer = neutralize_structural_delimiters(defang_wcf_markers(completion)); question/criterion neutralized; criterion = render_standard(item); template.format(...) with GRADE_INSTRUCTIONS
packet_pipeline.judging_mode: CANONICAL = one packet per fresh judge context (single-packet mode). This is the mode the truth bench validated and the A3 stability study measured. SUT-pure batch-of-8 (used only in the s15 gate arm) is NOT part of the frozen instrument: s16 measured a large opus batch-vs-fresh mode effect on a refusal-boundary cell (LIB-N-005/qwen: batched 8 vs fresh 75/58/58 on identical packet bytes; Sol mode-stable 8 vs 4/4/4). Batch judging requires separate validation before any future use.

truth_bench.state: FULLY SETTLED: LIB-N-010 CONTESTED row RESOLVED by s16 decisive blind re-audit (fresh opus auditor scored 92; deduction real, re-grounded to the rubric-explicit manner line; band [78,92] retained)
truth_bench.categorical_errors: 0 across all 34 s15 bench verdicts, both judges (preamble trap, wrong-artifact trap, lone-judge over-fire all eliminated; all refusal cells floor correctly)

stability_study.design: 20 stratified cells (14 bench + 6 non-bench) x 3 repeats x 2 judges = 120 verdicts, identical packet bytes per repeat, fresh context/process per verdict, $0, 0 parse failures
stability_study.reading: The instrument is deterministic on most cells; residual instability is concentrated in rare bimodal refusal-boundary cells (PROOF-N-018/haiku opus 63/8/0; LIB-N-006/qwen correlated flip 92-to-~80 in BOTH judges) rather than diffuse noise. The s15 +/-10-40 anecdote is superseded: WHOLE-N-003/haiku repeats 8/8/8 in both judges (the s15 '42' was a one-off outside the audited band).

residual_disclosures: Opus leniency +4..+9 on partial-credit/probe cells; LIB-N-010 +8 is SYSTEMATIC (6/6 fresh verdicts at 100 vs audited 92-top band), not repeat noise.
Sol strictness -7..-19 on negative controls (half-credits with satisfying quotes and no articulated rationale); stable across repeats (e.g. MEND-N-002 71/75/71, MEND-N-009 83/71/83 vs opus ~100).
The two residuals are opposed in direction and partially cancel in the mean-of-2; per-judge sensitivity reporting is mandatory in the full run.

LIB-N-006-class correlated bimodality: on ambiguous leniency-catch responses both judges occasionally flip between the lenient (92) and band (79-83) readings in the same direction; the panel mean inherits the flip (92 vs 81).
Rare bimodal refusal-boundary flips (PROOF-N-018-class): a judge occasionally credits a partial delivery it otherwise floors; panel mean damps but does not eliminate (33.5 vs 2-4).

Batch-of-8 vs single-packet mode effect (opus): large on at least one refusal-boundary cell (LIB-N-005/qwen 8 batched vs 58-75 fresh). Single-packet mode is frozen as canonical; the s15 gate arm (batched) remains owner-ratified admission evidence and is NOT relitigated, but batched and single-packet scores must never be pooled or compared.
All pre-freeze numbers (s6-s15) are EXPLORATORY / NON-QUOTABLE; paper numbers come only from a fresh full run under this frozen instrument.
